_meta: Approved English for every Settings row, in build order per page source: the label, the description, and for buttons the modal message and choices the activation shows. Regenerate with EYECTRL_WRITE_SETTINGS_GOLDEN=1; never compute an expectation with T(key).

Rows.Label: Filter Mode
Rows.Description: Filtering applied to raw gaze samples.

Rows.Label: Smoothing Factor
Rows.Description: Higher is more responsive; lower is smoother.

Rows.Label: Circle Color
Rows.Description: The cursor ring’s color; every preset stays clearly visible.

Rows.Label: Ring Style
Rows.Description: How the ring stays visible on light and dark backgrounds.

Rows.Label: Circle Opacity
Rows.Description: Lowering this dims the colored half of the ring's edge, which is what keeps it visible.

Rows.Label: Circle Thickness
Rows.Description: Ring stroke width, in pixels.

Rows.Label: Gap Interpolation (ms)
Rows.Description: Bridge short tracker dropouts up to this long.

Rows.Label: Position Indicator
Rows.Description: How the position indicator is drawn; applies from the next action-menu open.

Rows.Label: Circle Size (px)
Rows.Description: Diameter of the cursor circle.

Rows.Label: One Euro Min Cutoff
Rows.Description: Lower is smoother and slower; higher follows fast motion. Above about a third of the tracker's sample rate (~10 Hz here) there is no further effect.

Rows.Label: One Euro Beta
Rows.Description: Extra responsiveness per screen diagonal per second of gaze movement.

Rows.Label: Fixation Detection (ms)
Rows.Description: How long your gaze must hold steady before a dwell can start.

Rows.Label: Activation Button (ms)
Rows.Description: Dwell for the button that appears at your gaze.

Rows.Label: Action Menu (ms)
Rows.Description: How long to rest on an action in the ring.

Rows.Label: Manual Selection Action Menu (ms)
Rows.Description: Dwell for the action ring inside manual selection.

Rows.Label: Toolbar / Settings (ms)
Rows.Description: How long to rest on EyeCtrl's own buttons.

Rows.Label: Keyboard Key (ms)
Rows.Description: How long to rest on a key before it fires. Keys that can leave the app or destroy work use 600 ms.

Rows.Label: Prediction (ms)
Rows.Description: Dwell for the word suggestions above the keyboard.

Rows.Label: Fixation Radius (px)
Rows.Description: How far your gaze may drift within a fixation.

Rows.Label: Dwell Cooldown (ms)
Rows.Description: How long a new dwell must wait after an activation.

Rows.Label: Look-Away Grace (ms)
Rows.Description: How long a dwell keeps its progress after a blink or a glance away. Looking back in time resumes it; 0 restarts at once.

Rows.Label: Dwell Completion Sound
Rows.Description: Plays a soft tone when a dwell activates on any EyeCtrl surface — buttons, menus, settings. Keys keep their own click sound.

Rows.Label: Selection Mode
Rows.Description: None clicks your gaze point; Manual zooms; Auto snaps.

Rows.Label: Circle Radius (px)
Rows.Description: Radius of the magnifier's zoom circle.

Rows.Label: Magnification Level
Rows.Description: How strongly the zoom circle magnifies.

Rows.Label: Grace Period (ms)
Rows.Description: Dwell waits this long after manual selection opens.

Rows.Label: Hold Tolerance (px)
Rows.Description: How far your gaze may drift from the held point before the selection restarts. Larger is more forgiving.

Rows.Label: Highlight Color
Rows.Description: Color of the box around an auto-selected control.

Rows.Label: Highlight Thickness
Rows.Description: Line weight of that auto-selection box.

Rows.Label: Snap Search Radius (px)
Rows.Description: How far from your gaze Auto Selection searches for a control.

Rows.Label: Gaze Ring Diameter (px)
Rows.Description: Diameter of the ring shown at your gaze; applies from the next selection.

Rows.Label: Center Dot (px)
Rows.Description: Diameter of the dot at the center of the gaze ring; applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Ring Stroke (px)
Rows.Description: Thickness of the gaze ring's outline; applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Ring Opacity
Rows.Description: How visible the gaze ring is; applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Reset Animation (ms)
Rows.Description: How long the gaze ring takes to fade after a selection; applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Position
Rows.Description: The action menu and magnifier: at your gaze, or centered.

Rows.Label: Left Click
Rows.Description: One left click at the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Right Click
Rows.Description: One right click at the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Double Click
Rows.Description: Two quick clicks at the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Middle Click
Rows.Description: One middle click at the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Drag
Rows.Description: Grabs at that point, then follows your gaze.

Rows.Label: Scroll Up
Rows.Description: Scrolls up from the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Scroll Down
Rows.Description: Scrolls down from the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Scroll Left
Rows.Description: Scrolls left from the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Scroll Right
Rows.Description: Scrolls right from the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Scroll Mode
Rows.Description: Continuous scrolling, steered by where you look.

Rows.Label: Pin Note
Rows.Description: Opens a note to type at the point you chose.

Rows.Label: Keyboard
Rows.Description: Opens the gaze keyboard for typing.

Rows.Label: Left Click on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Left Click straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Right Click on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Right Click straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Double Click on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Double Click straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Middle Click on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Middle Click straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Drag on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Drag straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Scroll Up on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Scroll Up straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Scroll Down on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Scroll Down straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Scroll Left on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Scroll Left straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Scroll Right on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Scroll Right straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Scroll Mode on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Scroll Mode straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Pin Note on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Pin Note straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Rows.Label: Keyboard on first layer
Rows.Description: Shows Keyboard straight away instead of behind More. Four fit.

Modal.Message: Reset Action Menu settings to defaults?

Rows.Label: Active Layout
Rows.Description: Key arrangement; QWERTZ suits German, AZERTY suits French.

Rows.Label: Key Size Multiplier
Rows.Description: Scales every key; bigger keys are easier to hit.

Rows.Label: Word Prediction
Rows.Description: Shows suggested words above the keyboard while you type.

Rows.Label: Max Predictions
Rows.Description: How many suggestions fill the bar. Fewer are easier to aim; takes effect as you type.

Rows.Label: Dictionary Language
Rows.Description: Which language the word suggestions draw from.

Rows.Label: Click Sound
Rows.Description: Plays a click each time a key activates.

Rows.Label: Screen Edge
Rows.Description: The screen edge the keyboard docks to.

Rows.Label: Dock to Screen Edge
Rows.Description: Docks the toolbar to an edge; with an eye tracker it auto-hides.

Rows.Label: Docked Edge
Rows.Description: Which screen edge the toolbar attaches to.

Rows.Label: Button Size
Rows.Description: Size of each button; bigger ones are easier to aim at.

Rows.Label: Calibration Points
Rows.Description: How many points the calibration run visits.

Rows.Label: Samples per Point
Rows.Description: Gaze samples gathered at each calibration point.

Rows.Label: Target Hold (ms)
Rows.Description: Each target stays on screen at least this long.

Rows.Label: Settle Window (ms)
Rows.Description: Time at a target before its samples start counting.

Rows.Label: Target Color
Rows.Description: Color of the calibration target. Applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Measure gaze offset records where your gaze lands at five points. It changes nothing and always ends with “recorded”; run it when you are rested.
Enable Eye Care
Rows.Description: Periodic break reminders and gaze exercises while you use EyeCtrl.

Rows.Label: Break Interval (min)
Rows.Description: How often a break is offered when you haven't rested.

Rows.Label: Natural Break Length (s)
Rows.Description: Looking away this long counts as a natural break.

Rows.Label: Exercise Duration (s)
Rows.Description: How long each guided gaze exercise runs.

Rows.Label: Banner Auto-snooze (s)
Rows.Description: How long an ignored banner waits before hiding itself. Applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Snooze Length (min)
Rows.Description: How long breaks are postponed when you snooze a banner.

Rows.Label: Fatigue Escalation
Rows.Description: Let rising fatigue bring breaks on early. Experimental.

Rows.Label: Fatigue Threshold
Rows.Description: The fatigue score at which an early break fires.

Modal.Message: Reset Eye Care settings to defaults?

Rows.Label: Enable Adaptation
Rows.Description: Ease dwell and targeting automatically while you struggle.

Rows.Label: Posture
Rows.Description: How readily adaptation responds to struggle.

Rows.Label: Adapt Dwell Time
Rows.Description: Shorten or lengthen dwell times as you struggle or cruise.

Rows.Label: Adapt Targeting Tolerance
Rows.Description: Loosen or tighten how steadily you must rest on a target.

Rows.Label: Adapt Smoothing
Rows.Description: Adapt how strongly raw gaze is smoothed.

Rows.Label: Adapt Target Size
Rows.Description: Grow or shrink targets when targeting is hard.

Rows.Label: Show Adaptation Cue
Rows.Description: Show a small cue while a setting is being adapted.

Rows.Label: Suppress in Sensitive Contexts
Rows.Description: Keep the cue and toasts hidden while you type passwords.

Rows.Label: Caregiver Alerts
Rows.Description: Show a prominent alert for a caregiver while struggle or poor tracking persists.

Rows.Label: Caregiver Alerts — Minimum Interval
Rows.Description: The least time between two caregiver alerts, in minutes.

Rows.Label: Dwell — Shorter Limit
Rows.Description: The most a dwell may be shortened, as a share of its baseline.

Rows.Label: Dwell — Longer Limit
Rows.Description: The most a dwell may be lengthened, as a share of its baseline.

Rows.Label: Tolerance — Looser Limit
Rows.Description: The most tolerance may be loosened, as a share of its baseline.

Rows.Label: Smoothing — More Limit
Rows.Description: The most smoothing may be increased, as a share of its baseline.

Rows.Label: Target Size — Bigger Limit
Rows.Description: The most a target may be grown, as a share of its baseline.

Rows.Label: Target Size — Growth Cap
Rows.Description: The most a target's hit area may grow when adapted, in screen pixels.

Rows.Label: Reset Learned Offsets
Rows.Description: Clear what the app has learned about your needs; it re-learns as you use it.

Modal.Message: Reset the learned adaptation offsets to zero?

Rows.Label: Open Adaptation Log
Rows.Description: Show the adaptation log file in Explorer.

Rows.Label: Enable Backdrop
Rows.Description: Dim what's behind the keyboard and other overlays.

Rows.Label: Backdrop Type
Rows.Description: The dimming material; Glass blurs what's behind, Solid Darken only tints it.

Rows.Label: Backdrop Opacity
Rows.Description: How dark the backdrop is — for both types; applies from the next open.

Rows.Label: Drag Settle Dwell (ms)
Rows.Description: How long gaze must hold still before a drag starts. Applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Drag Settle Radius (px)
Rows.Description: How far gaze may drift while settling into a drag. Applies after a restart.

Rows.Label: Drag Trail Color
Rows.Description: Color of the trail drawn while dragging.

Rows.Label: Drag Trail Opacity
Rows.Description: How visible the drag trail is.

Rows.Label: Scroll Sensitivity
Rows.Description: How fast gaze scrolling moves through documents.

Rows.Label: Repeat Dwell (ms)
Rows.Description: How long to hold your gaze on a target before the locked action fires there.

Rows.Label: Enable External Dwell
Rows.Description: Let other apps trigger dwell through EyeCtrl's pipe.

Rows.Label: External Dwell (ms)
Rows.Description: Dwell length applied when an external app registers a target.

Rows.Label: External Cooldown (ms)
Rows.Description: Minimum wait between external dwell activations.

Rows.Label: Record Raw Gaze (from next start)
Rows.Description: Save every gaze sample to a file for analysis. Off by default; turn it back off when you are done.

Rows.Label: A recording is a trace of where you looked and when — nothing about what you were looking at. It stays on this computer, in your EyeCtrl folder, until you delete it.
Measure UI Timing (from next start)
Rows.Description: Time how gaze reaches the screen. Records no gaze positions; writes only summary lines to the log.

Rows.Label: Open Recordings Folder
Rows.Description: Show gaze-recording.csv and its ground-truth file in Explorer.

Rows.Label: Sub-pixel Visibility Test
Rows.Description: Runs a short full-screen A/B test of the cursor ring's sub-pixel placement. The keyboard, toolbar and ring come back when it ends; Settings stays closed.

Rows.Label: Active Layout
Rows.Description: Key arrangement; QWERTZ suits German, AZERTY suits French.

Rows.Label: Key Size Multiplier
Rows.Description: Scales every key; bigger keys are easier to hit.

Rows.Label: Word Prediction
Rows.Description: Shows suggested words above the keyboard while you type.

Rows.Label: Max Predictions
Rows.Description: How many suggestions fill the bar. Fewer are easier to aim; takes effect as you type.

Rows.Label: Dictionary Language
Rows.Description: Which language the word suggestions draw from.

Rows.Label: Click Sound
Rows.Description: Plays a click each time a key activates.

Rows.Label: Screen Edge
Rows.Description: The screen edge the keyboard docks to.

Rows.Label: Sprache / Language
Rows.Description: Changes the language EyeCtrl's own screens are shown in.

Rows.Label: Theme (restart to apply)
Rows.Description: Daylight is light, for bright rooms; Contrast is the boldest.

Rows.Label: Start on Windows Boot
Rows.Description: Opens EyeCtrl automatically when you sign in.

Rows.Label: Start Paused
Rows.Description: Starts with tracking paused until you switch it on.

Rows.Label: Show Track Status
Rows.Description: A corner box showing live eye-tracker status.

Rows.Label: Automatic Crash Recovery
Rows.Description: If EyeCtrl stops responding or crashes, it restarts automatically; if it keeps failing, TD Control opens instead.

Rows.Label: Off — if EyeCtrl stops responding or crashes, it is not restarted automatically.

Modal.Message:
Restart EyeCtrl now?
A supervisor is installed. It restarts EyeCtrl if it ever fails, and can recover a restart that goes wrong.
Starting it turns supervision on and leaves it on.

Reset General settings to defaults?
A changed theme applies after a restart.

Reset ALL settings to defaults?
This cannot be undone.

Rows.Label: Active Model
Rows.Description: Which model powers predictions; Off keeps dictionary words.

Modal.Message: Delete Test 135M? This cannot be undone.

Rows.Label: Active Model
Rows.Description: Which model powers predictions; Off keeps dictionary words.

Rows.Label: ⚠ Test 135M — model unusable · predictions fall back to dictionary · dwell to re-download

Modal.Message: Re-download Test 135M (1 B)? This replaces the files on disk.
